description:
Found by worker-a11dcf70 while measuring step 1 of task-24b68b05c865436ead05cd5ea375ff6f. PRE-EXISTING at HEAD 4161ad48, outside that row's owned paths, disclosed there as a path-attributed foreign red.

The three extra scanned declarations are all in apps/daemon/src/preview/preview-auto-decision.ts (landed by task-b8571cfe50614c1d89fee3a0a448de10, DONE): PREVIEW_AUTO_DECISION_LAYER, PREVIEW_AUTO_POLICY_LAYER, PREVIEW_AUTO_CODE_LAYERS.

CAUSE: boundary-roster.security.ts:621 SCAN_ROOTS includes "apps", and DECLARATION_PATTERN is `^export const ([A-Z0-9_]+(?:LAYERS|LAYER|BOUNDARIES))`. Neither `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` nor `pnpm typecheck` runs the security lane, so Gate 2's DoD gates were all green while this went red. FIX is either the four-coupled-edit roster backfill (LAYER_ROSTER row + axis case table + hostile case) or making the three constants module-private, which is the convention for refusal layers that never reach a wire (the module's own comment says they are deliberately not in PREVIEW_LAYERS or SERVICE_REFUSED_BY).
